Don't drop. Defend forward. — 浦和は『引かずに守る』ために3バックを使った

Urawa changed to a 3-4-2-1 and kept their first clean sheet of the 2026/27 league season. でも本質は『DFを1人増やした』ではない。The back three gave Urawa a spare defender against Kashima's two forwards, which allowed the team to press high, defend forward and still have cover behind the pressure. 後半に鹿島がinsideを使い始めてからの苦戦と再修正まで含めて振り返る。
